description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of seven distinct categories, likely representing data subsets from the referenced Fair-PP dataset. The chart is divided into seven slices, six of which are numerically labeled from 0 to 5 around the outer perimeter. Proceeding counter-clockwise from the top-left, category "0" is shown as a pale yellow slice comprising 13.3% (3910) of the total, followed by category "1" in light peach at 13.8% (4046), and category "2" in pale green at 22.4% (6583). Continuing counter-clockwise, category "3" is a light olive green slice at 6.8% (2002), category "4" is very light blue at 6.2% (1810), and category "5" is light blue at 10.4% (3043). The final and largest slice, positioned at the top, is grey-blue and accounts for 27.2% (8006); it lacks a visible external label, though a grey rectangular redaction mark appears directly above it. The chart does not utilize a separate legend. Instead, both the percentage and the raw count (enclosed in parentheses) are printed directly inside each corresponding slice. The segments are separated by thin white borders with no slices exploded, offset, or otherwise visually emphasized. Visually, the labeled categories are arranged in sequential numerical order (0 to 5) counter-clockwise, rather than being sorted by descending or ascending size.
